Tracy McGrady

Tracy Lamar McGrady Jr.

(T-Mac, The Big Sleep)

Position: Shooting Guard and Small Forward ▪ Shoots: Right

6-8, 210lb (203cm, 95kg)

Born: May 24, 1979 in Bartow, Florida us

Relatives: Cousin Vince Carter

High Schools: Auburndale in Auburndale, Florida, Mt. Zion Christian Academy in Durham, North Carolina

Draft: Toronto Raptors, 1st round (9th pick, 9th overall), 1997 NBA Draft

NBA Debut: October 31, 1997

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2017 (Full List)

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Tracy McGrady?

Tracy McGrady is 47 years old.

Where was Tracy McGrady born?

Tracy McGrady was born in Bartow, Florida.

When was Tracy McGrady born?

Tracy McGrady was born on May 24, 1979.

How tall is Tracy McGrady?

Tracy McGrady is 6-8 (203 cm) tall.

How much did Tracy McGrady weigh when playing?

Tracy McGrady weighed 210 lbs (95 kg) when playing.

Is Tracy McGrady in the Hall of Fame?

Tracy McGrady was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2017 (Full List) .

When was Tracy McGrady drafted?

Tracy McGrady was drafted by Toronto Raptors, 1st round (9th pick, 9th overall), 1997 NBA Draft.

What position did Tracy McGrady play?

Shooting Guard and Small Forward.

When did Tracy McGrady retire?

Tracy McGrady last played in 2013.

What is Tracy McGrady's net worth?

Tracy McGrady made at least $162,978,278 playing professional basketball.

How much did Tracy McGrady make?

Tracy McGrady made $23,239,562 in 2010.

What did Tracy McGrady average?

Tracy McGrady averaged 19.6 points, 5.6 rebounds, and 4.4 assists per game.

How many rings does Tracy McGrady have?

Tracy McGrady won 0 championships.

What schools did Tracy McGrady attend?

Tracy McGrady attended Auburndale in Auburndale, Florida and Mt. Zion Christian Academy in Durham, North Carolina.

What are Tracy McGrady's nicknames?

T-Mac, The Big Sleep are nicknames for Tracy McGrady.
